Interface RMIGameServer

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RMIServerNetworkAdapter
public interface RMIGameServer extends Remote
Remote server-side interface exposed via RMI. Clients obtain a stub from the registry and invoke these methods to send actions.

  • Method Details

    • createLobby

      String createLobby(String nickname, int numPlayers, RMIClientCallback callback) throws Exception
      Creates a new lobby, registers the first player, and reserves its nickname. The first player also defines the number of players expected for the match.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the chosen nickname of the player creating the lobby
      numPlayers - the total number of players expected in the lobby
      callback - the remote callback used by the server to notify the client
      Returns:
      the generated game ID for the new lobby
      Throws:
      Exception - if lobby creation, nickname reservation, or player registration fails

    • joinLobby

      void joinLobby(String nickname, String gameID, RMIClientCallback callback) throws Exception
      Joins an existing lobby using the provided game ID and registers the client callback.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the chosen nickname of the joining player
      gameID - the ID of the lobby to join
      callback - the remote callback used by the server to notify the client
      Throws:
      Exception - if the lobby does not exist, is already started, the nickname is already used, or player registration fails
